data.description: The solo sub is a one-person submarine that fires torpedoes, with room for up to 100 of them and 18 slots of storage. As for cost, the [Boat Vendor](/world/boat-vendor) at Fishing Villages sells it for 200 [scrap](/items/scrap), with 50 low grade fuel in the tank. It burns 7 low grade per minute, so a full 500 tank lasts about 71 minutes. It won't decay parked inside, but takes 3 hours outside or 2 in deep water.
